# MCP tools reference

Tools exposed by the WeRForces MCP server (`/mcp` or `dist/mcp/stdio.js`). See [Tutorial 5](../tutorials/05-ai-agents-with-mcp.md) for setup.

Instructions sent to the client when it connects:

> WeRForces is a computer-generated forces (CGF) military simulation.
> Start with get_situation to learn the scenario, forces, terrain size and town names.
> Positions are local metres (x east, y north, from the south-west corner) or {lat,lon} or {town:"Name"}.
> Forces: 1 = Blue, 2 = Red, 3 = Neutral. Entities can be grouped into units (ids U..); task a unit to move it in formation.
> Use list_catalog for entity type and unit template ids. Use advance_time to simulate while paused and get a summary of what happened.

## `get_situation` _(read-only)_

Overview of the simulation: scenario, time, running state, strength per force, terrain size and towns, units and tactical graphics. Call this first.

No parameters.

## `list_entities` _(read-only)_

List entities with position, damage and current activity. Filter by force, domain or unit.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `force` | `1` or `2` or `3` or `0` |  | 1 Blue, 2 Red, 3 Neutral, 0 Other |
| `domain` | `"ground"` \| `"lifeform"` \| `"air"` \| `"surface"` |  |  |
| `unitId` | string |  |  |
| `aliveOnly` | boolean |  | exclude destroyed entities |

## `get_entity` _(read-only)_

Full details of one entity: kinematics, damage, ROE, task/plan, ammunition and current sensor contacts.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | yes |  |

## `get_unit` _(read-only)_

Details of a unit and its members.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | yes |  |

## `list_catalog` _(read-only)_

Entity types and unit templates that can be created.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `what` | `"entityTypes"` \| `"unitTemplates"` \| `"both"` |  |  |

## `get_events` _(read-only)_

Recent simulation events (detections, fire, hits, kills, task changes). Use `since` with the last seq you saw.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `since` | integer (-9007199254740991–9007199254740991) |  |  |
| `kinds` | array of `"fire"` \| `"detonation"` \| `"damaged"` \| `"destroyed"` \| `"detected"` \| `"task"` \| `"created"` \| `"deleted"` \| `"info"` |  |  |
| `limit` | integer (1–500) |  |  |

## `query_terrain` _(read-only)_

Terrain at a point: elevation, water, forest, road, slope and nearest town.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `at` | {x, y, lat, lon, town} | yes | Location as {x,y}, {lat,lon} or {town} |

## `check_line_of_sight` _(read-only)_

Whether two entities (by id) or points can see each other over terrain and forest.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `from` | string or {x, y, lat, lon, town} | yes |  |
| `to` | string or {x, y, lat, lon, town} | yes |  |

## `create_entity`

Create a single entity (vehicle, aircraft, ship or person) from an entity type id.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `typeId` | string | yes |  |
| `force` | `1` or `2` or `3` or `0` | yes | 1 Blue, 2 Red, 3 Neutral, 0 Other |
| `position` | {x, y, lat, lon, town} | yes | Location as {x,y}, {lat,lon} or {town} |
| `heading` | number |  | degrees clockwise from north |
| `name` | string |  |  |
| `altitude` | number |  | aircraft height above ground, m |

## `create_unit`

Create a unit (e.g. a tank platoon) from a unit template id; members are placed in formation.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `templateId` | string | yes |  |
| `force` | `1` or `2` or `3` or `0` | yes | 1 Blue, 2 Red, 3 Neutral, 0 Other |
| `position` | {x, y, lat, lon, town} | yes | Location as {x,y}, {lat,lon} or {town} |
| `heading` | number |  | degrees |
| `name` | string |  |  |

## `create_graphic`

Draw a tactical graphic: a route (for follow/patrol tasks), an area (for "in area" plan conditions), a phase line or a point.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `kind` | `"route"` \| `"area"` \| `"phaseLine"` \| `"point"` | yes |  |
| `points` | array of {x, y, lat, lon, town} | yes |  |
| `name` | string |  |  |
| `force` | `1` or `2` or `3` or `0` |  | 1 Blue, 2 Red, 3 Neutral, 0 Other |

## `delete_object` _(destructive)_

Delete an entity, a unit (with its members) or a graphic.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | yes |  |

## `assign_task`

Give an entity or unit a task (replaces its current plan). moveTo/orbit need `to`; followRoute/patrol need `routeId`; attack/follow need `targetId`; wait needs `duration`.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `targetId` | string | yes | entity (E..) or unit (U..) id |
| `type` | `"moveTo"` \| `"followRoute"` \| `"patrol"` \| `"attack"` \| `"follow"` \| `"orbit"` \| `"wait"` | yes |  |
| `to` | {x, y, lat, lon, town} |  | Location as {x,y}, {lat,lon} or {town} |
| `routeId` | string |  |  |
| `targetEntityId` | string |  |  |
| `duration` | number |  | seconds |
| `radius` | number |  | orbit radius in m (default 2000) |
| `speedKmh` | number |  |  |

## `assign_plan`

Give an entity or unit a plan: an ordered list of statements executed in sequence. Statement kinds: {kind:"task", task:{type:"moveTo",target:{town:"X"}}} (task types as in assign_task, with target/center positions), {kind:"setRoe", roe}, {kind:"setSpeed", speed (m/s)}, {kind:"setAltitude", altitude}, {kind:"setFormation", formation}, {kind:"waitUntil", condition:{type:"simTime",time}|{type:"inArea",areaId}|{type:"enemyDetected"}|{type:"underFire"}|{type:"entityDestroyed",entityId}}.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `targetId` | string | yes |  |
| `name` | string |  |  |
| `loop` | boolean |  |  |
| `statements` | array of object | yes |  |

## `stop`

Stop an entity or unit (clears its task and plan).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `targetId` | string | yes |  |

## `set_roe` _(idempotent)_

Set rules of engagement for an entity or unit: fireAtWill, returnFire or holdFire.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `targetId` | string | yes |  |
| `roe` | `"fireAtWill"` \| `"returnFire"` \| `"holdFire"` | yes |  |

## `control_simulation`

Run (real time), pause, rewind to the scenario start, or set the real-time multiplier.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `action` | `"run"` \| `"pause"` \| `"rewind"` \| `"setTimeScale"` | yes |  |
| `timeScale` | number (0.1–64) |  |  |

## `advance_time`

Simulate the given number of seconds immediately (as fast as possible) and summarise what happened: kills, damage, detections and task changes.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `seconds` | number (1–3600) | yes |  |
| `includeDetections` | boolean |  |  |

## `manage_scenario`

List, load or save scenarios stored on the server, or start an empty one.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `action` | `"list"` \| `"load"` \| `"save"` \| `"new"` | yes |  |
| `name` | string |  |  |
